```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)

    # ---- totals ----
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if rev_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if rev_ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY)")
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", num((rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(u_tw), "sum(Units_TW)")
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", num((u_tw - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(o_tw), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", num((o_tw - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # ---- top entities by this week's revenue ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for the entity")
        if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", num(r["Share_Pct"], 1),
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # top-5 concentration
    if rev_tw > 0 and len(top) > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # rank 1 entity
    if "Rank" in df.columns and df["Rank"].notna().any():
        top1 = df.loc[df["Rank"].idxmin()]
        add(top1["Entity"], "rank", "TW", num(top1["Rank"], 0), "min(Rank) by Revenue_TW")

    # ---- biggest WoW movers (absolute revenue change, material base) ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    if len(d):
        d["abs_chg"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
        up = d.sort_values("abs_chg", ascending=False).head(3)
        for _, r in up.iterrows():
            if r["abs_chg"] > 0:
                add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["abs_chg"]),
                    "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
        dn = d.sort_values("abs_chg").head(3)
        for _, r in dn.iterrows():
            if r["abs_chg"] < 0:
                add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["abs_chg"]),
                    "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # ---- biggest WoW percent movers among sizeable entities ----
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct", "Revenue_TW"]).copy()
    if len(p):
        thr = p["Revenue_TW"].median()
        p = p[p["Revenue_TW"] >= thr]
        if len(p):
            best = p.loc[p["WoW_Pct"].idxmax()]
            worst = p.loc[p["WoW_Pct"].idxmin()]
            add(best["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(best["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
            add(worst["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(worst["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct", "Revenue_TW"]).copy()
    if len(y):
        ybest = y.loc[y["YoY_Pct"].idxmax()]
        yworst = y.loc[y["YoY_Pct"].idxmin()]
        add(ybest["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(ybest["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
        add(yworst["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(yworst["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # ---- volume leaders ----
    if df["Units_TW"].notna().any():
        ru = df.loc[df["Units_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(ru["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(ru["Units_TW"], 0), "max(Units_TW)")
    if df["Orders_TW"].notna().any():
        ro = df.loc[df["Orders_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(ro["Entity"], "orders", "TW", num(ro["Orders_TW"], 0), "max(Orders_TW)")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
